CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2834 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 9e212cd0e3687575e764517916f5057d79c8e01a. Bus nonce: 2487dee5866579c3b064cbff49fa6ab6. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 9e212cd0e3687575e764517916f5057d79c8e01a`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 9e212cd0e3687575e764517916f5057d79c8e01a` or `Fix review: blocked 9e212cd0e3687575e764517916f5057d79c8e01a <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 2487dee5866579c3b064cbff49fa6ab6`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `9e212cd0e3687575e764517916f5057d79c8e01a` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2834 9e212cd0e3687575e764517916f5057d79c8e01a") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2834-2487dee5`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

DELTA REVIEWER (opus) for PR #2834, R10-ADVISOR-RESIDUE (topic r10-advisor-residue), at head 9e212cd0e3687575e764517916f5057d79c8e01a, nonce 2487dee5866579c3b064cbff49fa6ab6. Contract: dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md from origin/main. Review from a detached worktree at that head, with the FINDER's harness and the committed instrument dev/audit/harnesses/r10_advisor_residue.py, never the fixer's own claims.
PRIOR VERDICT: round 1 was MERGE at 313a19d9189f7bbd87bcfbfe8dc231b8dbb4d3df (probe/rev-2834-9895de2a, bus-nonce 9895de2a44181f8f1185f1faa1586e5d). It found seam (a), the what-if panel, still open with Carry: #2257, and the body then said `Part of #2257`. Read that verdict first; do not re-review what it settled and the delta did not touch (git diff 313a19d91...9e212cd0e shows what moved).
WHAT MOVED SINCE (verify each from the three-dot diff and the branch history):
1. e2a808a6 was red: tests / mutation showed 2 new unpinned sites at custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/coordinator.py:2030 (CLAMP_DROP and CMP_BOUND) the autofix did not cure, and pr-contract was red. The fixer round (handoff e01608bd, body 937581f7) owed, per site, a killing check that FAILS on the mutant, or a survivor_triage entry with a reason. Re-run both mutants yourself at the head: each must be killed by a named check, or carry a triage entry whose reason you test. A pin that passes with the mutant applied is a finding.
2. The body now says `Closes #2257`. The round-1 residual says seam (a) (the what-if panel, WhatIf.summary reading the single-solve monthly_cost_delta) stays OPEN and the follow-on sub-PR owns it and closes #2257. Decide whether closing #2257 here is true: re-run the harness `whatif` arm at the head. If seam (a) is still open, the Closes keyword is a defect (a premature close), unless the body justifies it with evidence you can reproduce, or the roster re-routed the group. Check the roster at origin/main for group R10-ADVISOR-RESIDUE and its carry 10.
3. Everything else must equal round 1: no custom_components change outside the two pinned sites and their checks, claims files, VERSION, manifest and RELEASE_NOTES.md untouched, env_drift --all clean, structure ratchet not raised, body head = this head, merge-tree against current origin/main clean.
Read check-runs of the head from the API (not pr checks); every Red checks entry in the body must match a real check-run. Re-take the verdict nonce into the verdict file as bus-nonce 2487dee5866579c3b064cbff49fa6ab6 and report MERGE or BLOCKED per the verdict shapes in the role contract. No Claude footers, no host paths.
